findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "vastu" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: post_vastu_rooms, post_vastu_timing_griha_pravesh · Public sink: post_vastu_entrance, post_vastu_mandala, post_vastu_plot, post_vastu_ayadi, post_vastu_rooms, post_vastu_timing_griha_pravesh.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: post_vastu_rooms, post_vastu_timing_griha_pravesh · Public sink: post_vastu_entrance, post_vastu_mandala, post_vastu_plot, post_vastu_ayadi, post_vastu_rooms, post_vastu_timing_griha_pravesh

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
